purpose: Frequent observation, selective buy/sell/hold; maximize tested net performance subject to explicit comparisons, not a guarantee of future maximum profit.
contamination: Prior work has already examined daily BTC/ETH data throughout these years and BTC intraday 2022-2026. Historical evaluation here is reused-data exploratory research, NOT an independent unseen confirmation. ETH intraday transfer is frozen without retuning but is correlated and its daily history was also seen.

families.buffer_momentum: 30-day return must exceed band for entry and fall below negative half-band for exit. Require positive completed 4h MA5/20 trend for entry. Band=max(0.5% or 1%, 0.25 or 0.5 times completed daily ATR14/price).
families.trend_agreement: Completed daily MA5>MA20, close>daily MA60, completed 4h MA5>MA20. 4h normalized MA gap must exceed band/2. Exit daily MA5<MA20*(1-band/2) OR 4h close below MA20 by band.
families.breakout: Current completed 15m close exceeds preceding 72h high by 0.1 or 0.25 times 4h ATR14; daily close>MA60; current volume>=1.0 or 1.5 times preceding 24h mean volume. Entry confirmation is 1 observation (breakout is an event). Exit below preceding 36h low.
families.pullback: Daily MA5>MA20 and daily close>MA60. Arm on a dip below completed hourly MA20 minus 0.5 or 1.0 times hourly ATR14 within preceding 24h; enter after 2 or 4 consecutive 15m closes reclaim hourly MA20. Exit on negative daily MA5/20 trend or shared protection.
families.range_reversion: Daily MA20 changes <2% over 5 days and abs(4h MA5-MA20)<0.5*4h ATR14. Current close z-score versus completed hourly 48-bar mean/std below -1.5 or -2.0, last two 15m closes rising, distance to hourly mean>=3 or 4 assumed round-trip cost units. Entry confirmation 1 observation. Exit at hourly mean or after 48h or shared protection.
families.daily_fast_guard: Entry eligibility is daily MA5>MA20; enter only after current close>completed 4h MA20 for 2 or 4 observations. Exit on daily regime off or shared protection.
families.ridge_forecast: Two fixed ridge penalties 10 and 100. Seven causal features: log returns 1d/7d/30d, daily MA5/20 ratio, daily volatility20, hourly MA20 deviation, 4h MA5/20 ratio. Train on at most preceding 730 daily samples with 24h future return labels; latest label fully realized before fit, >=180 samples. Refit at quarter start, predict at 15m intervals. Enter predicted log return >3 times base round-trip cost; exit forecast<0. Confirmation 4 bars, cooldown24h, shared protection. This is a hypothesis, not a calibrated probability or guaranteed forecast.
families.consensus: Three votes: positive 30d return beyond band, daily MA5>MA20 plus daily close>MA60, positive 4h MA5/20 beyond band/2. Enter on 2 or 3 votes for 2 or 4 observations; exit on <=1 vote. Shared protection.

common_selectivity.parameters: Two predeclared settings for each non-ridge family: L (entry confirmation 2 bars, cooldown6h, stop2*ATR4h, trailing3*ATR4h, cost opportunity multiplier3); S (confirmation4, cooldown24h, stop3*ATR4h, trailing4*ATR4h, multiplier4). Event families override confirmation as stated.
common_selectivity.opportunity_gate: Entry requires 2*completed 4h ATR14/price >= multiplier*0.004. This only screens available movement against assumed cost; volatility is NOT expected profit. Same threshold in all cost stress runs so the strategy is unchanged.
common_selectivity.shock_gate: Do not enter if last 15m close change exceeds 2*completed hourly ATR14 or 4h ATR/price >8%; no entry on zero-volume signal bar.
common_selectivity.position_management: One long position, no pyramiding, no periodic rebalance. Buy target fraction of current equity once; hold unchanged until an exit. Initial stop distance=max(2%, stop-multiple*ATR4h), trailing distance=max(2%, trailing-multiple*ATR4h), both fixed using ATR known at entry. Trail uses maximum completed close since entry. Protection overrides holding/cooldown. Maximum holding60days except range48h. Stops are observed at 15m close, not guaranteed intrabar fills.
common_selectivity.action_semantics: While flat, buy only after all entry gates and persistence pass; otherwise wait. While holding, sell only on rule/protection exit; otherwise hold. A protective exit does not block future entries indefinitely; reentry requires cooldown and fresh consecutive entry confirmations.

execution: All indicators use completed bars only. Decision at boundary after last completed 15m candle, execution at 15m open 15 minutes later. Buy price rounded up/sell down to JPY1 with adverse slippage. Defer pending intent over zero-volume/missing bars. No earlier favorable fills or stop-price fills. Final liquidation included. Mark all strategies on each 15m close; also report conservative low-versus-previous-close-peak drawdown diagnostic.
benchmarks: same daily MA5/20 eligibility observed every15m (equivalence control)

selection.profit_leader: Highest DEVELOPMENT fractional base CAGR among16, positive return and >=8 completed round trips; no drawdown constraint, explicitly a historical profit objective.
selection.robust_candidate: Among DEVELOPMENT fractional results: base and stress net return positive, base MDD<=20%, >=8 completed round trips, >=2 positive calendar years out of3. Maximize base CAGR-0.5*MDD. If none cash. No requirement that every year be positive.
selection.freeze: Both identities and all parameters fixed before opening validation results. Do not switch to a retrospective test winner.
selection.validation_gate: Frozen robust candidate: 2023-2024 fractional+lot base+stress returns positive, lot MDD<=20%, base lot total return >=daily MA5/20. Failure does not trigger reselection.
selection.confirmation_gate: Frozen robust candidate: 2025-2026 fractional+lot base+stress returns positive, lot MDD<=20%, lot total return >=daily MA5/20; still only a paper observation candidate due to reused history.

diagnostics: All16 candidates, including failures, every split and BTC yearly
ETH all16 transfer without reselection,2022-2024 and2025-2026
Frozen leaders allocation50%/100%, initial1000/100000JPY, execution lag0/30min, current-fee proxy, threshold0.8x/1.2x for non-ridge robust candidate
Ablations for frozen robust: disable opportunity/shock entry gates; disable protection; remove cooldown; disable confirmation; evaluate separately, never select by these results
Paired daily equity return differences against daily baseline, circular30/90day block bootstrap5000, descriptive intervals not selection-adjusted
Zero-action observations, roundtrips, win rate, average net trade PnL, time in market, fees, drawdowns, yen profits and annualized returns
Data timestamps, gaps, zero volume, aggregates and causal-signal/ledger tests
update_method: Freeze an eventual paper candidate at least90days. Review quarterly, do not select recent winners automatically. Store every proposed change before its test, keep old rule as shadow, promote only after new prospective >=180days and>=20roundtrips with predeclared cost/risk benchmark comparisons. Ridge fitting, if used, follows its fixed quarterly past-label schedule and does not rewrite rules.
limits: 16 candidates are a finite research set, not all possible strategies or a global optimum
Previous32 candidates plus this16 increases selection bias; exploratory variants add further trials
No historical order-book queue/fill probabilities, maker fills or rebates assumed
No taxes, subscription, electricity or withdrawal costs
Current lot/tick rules are proxies for historical rules
Two correlated surviving assets and one venue; no FX/equity claims
No automatic real-money trading, scheduler, external messages or paid service
